Here is a summary of the teaching demonstration transcript in 2-3 concise sentences:

The speaker, Marina Denilevsky, introduces Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) as a framework to improve the accuracy and up-to-dateness of large language models (LLMs). She uses an anecdote about answering her kids' question about which planet has the most moons to illustrate two common challenges with LLMs: providing unverified information and being outdated. By incorporating RAG, she proposes adding a content store that can be used in conjunction with the LLM to provide more reliable and current answers.
